notes.title: Game UPDATES released!
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that the game updates to the Battles of the Valiant Universe are LIVE now. After many, many months of work, we are thrilled to have you play the game and receive your feedback.  

So, you are probably asking yourself, what’s new?

Well, let’s get started with the [b] challenge a friend[/b] feature. You are able to challenge any friend that has the game installed. If they don’t have the game installed, you can invite your Steam friends to install the game and play.

[b]Crafting.[/b] The crafting system will allow you to earn Gold coins and is another way to obtain Gold coins to spend in the Store.

[b]Gold coins.[/b] You will be able to purchase Gold coins that will allow you to buy booster packs in the Store. Players are still able to use Silver coins for crafting to earn additional Gold coins.

[b]Quests.[/b] By completing quests you will be able to earn additional Silver coins, specific cards, and booster packs.

We are well aware that the game will need some polishing so please, please hang in there with us. Enjoy playing Battles of the Valiant Universe!

Your feedback is valuable, so please leave us a note, or email us at team@silentlengeds.com.

Stay Valiant!  
Silent Legends Team
